scope: Story advancement no longer creates a separate event worker merely to enqueue presentation and request persistence.
The current recipient uses the existing bounded priority queue; persistence requests use the fresh-state coalesced save path.
Full or closed presentation queues do not suppress the current owner's save request. Missing, empty or retired recipients do not queue work.
No changes to manual turn-in, quest acceptance, reward arithmetic, story ordering, earned-completion journals or save durability acknowledgement.

evidence: Callback returns with world, entity, character-work and snapshot locks deliberately held; presentation is current-recipient only and subsequent save retains ownership.
Full and closed queues still persist completed Chronicle state, granted Gold/XP and canonical Gold, without replacing a previously queued receipt.
Empty message/identifier, missing and retired recipients cannot create presentation or saves.
Existing feedback-pressure, coalesced-save burst, journal recovery, owner serialization, stale cleanup and final shutdown regressions also pass.

game.scope: Two short in-process story-order/manual-turn-in regressions, not an uninterrupted campaign or human pacing test.

limits: The earlier e1d84ac0 real-server account/resource receipt predates this callback change and retains that scope; it is not relabeled as proof of this callback.
Other cleanup, presence and critical completion workers remain separate admission work. This closes one redundant event-worker path, not all denial-of-service or player-capacity gates.
No 1.72 promotion, CI deployment or public acceptance is claimed.
